text: unique. Very unique.  Arrived very well packed and whole.  It is dishwasher/microwave safe which was the biggest draw for me.  It looks like it hold a good amount of tea and the lid should keep it warm longer.  Over all, I like it.

product_metadata.title: Sun's Tea (TM) 12oz Personal All Glass Made Tea Infuser & Mug (Teapot)
features: Ultra clear glass, you can watch tea leaves 'dance' while infusing, a beeter way to brew loose tea.
Removable glass infuser, perfect to use with loose tea or tea bag
Entirely made of lead free and heat-resistant durable borosilicate glass, no metal or pastic part
Sun's Tea (TM) 12 oz (0.35L) portable galss mug with infuser, perfect size for work and home
description: The Personal Glass Teapot is elegant, convenient (the lid doubles as a coaster.) and has a handy, removable infuser. Dishwasher safe! Brew the leaves alone in the pot and watch their "dance," then place the infuser in the cup and pour through the infuser which will catch the leaves. Or, fill the infuser with dry leaves, place it into the pot then pour the water on the leaves. After brewing, lift out the infuser and pour the infused tea into your waiting cup. Clearly, a wonderful addition to the office desk or the kitchen counter. * Sun's Tea(TM) is the trade maker owned by SUN Valley Enterprises LLC since 2001
